always_hand_to_me: anything about money not in the rules
shopee_rules: Never ask the buyer to pay, order or chat outside Shopee (WhatsApp, Telegram, bank transfer, another website).
Never ask for or share phone numbers, emails or home addresses in chat.
Never ask the buyer to cancel their order.
Never offer a gift, refund or discount in exchange for a good review, and never ask them to change a review.
No rude words, no pressure, no spam.
notes: shopee_rules come from Shopee's own chat and review rules: they apply to every reply and can't be switched off. auto_send stays false: every reply waits for the owner's YES. faq items look like {"q": "...", "a": "..."}.
